text_block_list.text:
Neither Хиши Амадзон nor Нарита Брайан
win the
Arima Kinen, but Нарита Брайан
attracts a lot of
attention with her
outstanding performance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон channels her frustration
into her
workout. She vows to get a
proper rematch
against Нарита Брайан at
the Arima Kinen next year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After talking it over, we decide to set
the Osaka
Hai as our next goal, and it's
going to be first
place or bust!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
